item.title: [NEW] If Apple School Manager asks you to approve new terms and conditions
item.description:
Apple sometimes updates the macOS, iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, or tvOS Software License Agreement, often when releasing a new OS version. When a Software License Agreement is updated, an Apple School Manager Administrator must sign in to the program web portal to review and agree to the updated terms.
